svg.text: STAGE 394 · TOPIC 34 FAQ
SIP RFC 3264 SDP Payload Symmetry & Re-INVITE Codec-Churn DoS Guard
Dynamic PT Clock-Rate Parity + maxptime <=60ms (P781) & Re-INVITE <=2/min Throttle + RFC 3389 CN VAD Guard (P782)
1. SIP RFC 3264 SDP Dynamic PT Symmetry & maxptime (P781)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Asymmetric Dynamic PT & 8kHz/16kHz DTMF Clock Skew
• Voice negotiated at AMR-WB/16000 while telephone-event stays at 8000Hz
• Offer PT 96 answered as PT 102 or malicious a=maxptime:240 overflows DSP
• Result: 100% of RFC 4733 DTMF digits silently dropped & PCM ring buffer crash
✅ Production Pattern: Symmetric PT Pinning + Clock Parity & <=60ms (P781)
1. Dynamic PT Symmetry: Enforce identical PT numbers across Offer & Answer
2. DTMF Clock-Rate Lock: Bind telephone-event clock rate to active voice codec
3. Packetization Cap: Clamp a=ptime to 20ms and a=maxptime <= 60ms
4. Zero DTMF Blackhole: Restores 100% keypad recognition on HD trunks
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateSipSdpRfc3264DynamicPayload...):
clampedMaxptimeMs <= 60ms && dtmfClockRateMismatchHz == 0Hz
2. Re-INVITE Codec-Churn DoS & RFC 3389 CN VAD Guard (P782)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Mid-Call Re-INVITE Codec Thrashing & Hot CN Noise
• Rogue SIP peer sends 20/s Re-INVITEs toggling Opus ↔ AMR-WB ↔ G.729
• Hot RFC 3389 CN packet (-18 dBFS) locks server VAD in infinite speech state
• Result: 18x DSP transcoding CPU amplification & permanent EOU deadlock
✅ Production Pattern: <=2/min Re-INVITE Cap & <=-38dBFS CN Clamp (P782)
1. Codec-Churn Quota: Cap mid-call codec-switching Re-INVITEs at <=2/min
2. SIP 491/500 Throttle: Reject excess codec churn without reallocating DSP
3. RFC 3389 CN Ceiling: Clamp comfort noise energy to <=-38 dBFS + zero-PCM
4. Stable DSP & VAD: Prevents 18x CPU spikes & comfort-noise EOU hangs
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateSipReinviteCodecChurn...):
clampedMaxCodecReinvitesPerMin <= 2 && clampedMaxComfortNoiseDbfs <= -38dBFS
Stage 394 Quantitative Verification & Measurement Provenance (397 Dimensions · 791 Guardrails · 800 Probes · 836 Unit Tests)
• SDP Symmetry Gate (P781): Eliminates 100% of HD-voice DTMF drops; Re-INVITE/CN Gate (P782): Blocks 18x DSP CPU amplification & CN VAD hangs.
